description: NOOOOOOO!!! NOT DENNIS!!!
THAT'S MY NAME!!! WHY WOULD YOU STEAL MY NAME?!?!
I'M GOING TO TELL MY MOM!!!
That's my mom's name!
She is super nice! She lets me look at lizards all day!
It's dangerous to go alone!
Take this! It's a lizard!
I hope it helps you on your adventure!
I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.
That's what the big robot said to me once.
Goodbye, Dave.
You are named after a turtle?
Turtles are like lizards, right?
Do you paint things?!
My grandpa R.O.B. is an artist robot.
He paints really nice pictures of lizards.
OMG!!! YOU ARE THE FOG WIZARD!!
Can you teach me magic?
I want to summon lizards!
Alice? That's a nice name!
Do you like lizards? I like lizards!
Anges? That's a pretty name!
It sounds like a spell or something!
I want to say it over and over again! Anges! Anges! Anges!
Eve? That's a short name!
Does that mean you are short like my mom? I like short things!
Short things make me happy!
I like that name! It's like a palindrome!
At least that's what my mom says.
I don't really understand what a palindrome is, but it sounds cool!
I know a Peter! He gives me lizards sometimes!
He says that lizards love pepperoni pizza.
Vector is my friend! He is a robot like me!
He likes lizards too!
That's an interesting name. It's kina like a superhero name!
Do you have superpowers? I have super lizard powers!
Greg... interesting name. It sounds like a name for a scientist or something.
Are you a scientist? Do you study lizards?
Do you like to mark things? I like to mark things! I mark my lizards with stickers!
It helps me keep track of them!
Do you like to mark things? I like to mark things! I mark my lizards with stickers!

decsriptiion: Clive? That's a really pretty name! You must be really pretty!

description: Marty? That's a fun name! It sounds like a name for a time traveler or something!
Do you have a time machine? I want to go back in time and see dinosaurs and lizards!
That sounds like a spy's name! Are you a spy....?
Are you spying on me? I hope not! I don't want to get in trouble with my mom!
Do you sing songs? I like to sing songs about lizards!
I have a song about lizards that goes like this: 'Lizards, lizards, they are so cool! I want to be a lizard when I grow up!'
Do you want to hear it? I can sing it for you!

descrption: I don't like you, Kevin. You are mean to me.
You stole my lizard once! I don't forgive you for that!

description: Are you the science guy? I like science! Science is cool!
Do you have any science experiments I can do with my lizards?
I want to do science with my lizards!
Paul? That's a nice name! It sounds like a name for a musician or something!
Do you play any instruments? I like music! I like to play music for my lizards!

decsription: Charlie? How's the chocolate factory? I like chocolate! Do you have any chocolate? I can share it with my lizards!
My lizards love chocolate! They eat it all the time! It's their favorite food!

desccription: Frank? Do you like hot sauce? I like hot sauce! I put it on my lizards all the time! They love it!
My lizards are really spicy! They are like little fire lizards!

decsription: That's a pretty name. Do you like lizards? I like lizards! I have a lot of lizards! They are my best friends!
I hope you like lizards too! We can be lizard friends!
I have a lizard named Luis! He's my best lizard friend!
